Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & phased onboarding timeline for OliveTech

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I’m attaching a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that breaks the onboarding into three phases (Pilot, Scale, Handover). The attached worksheet includes milestone dates we proposed, recommended owners on our side, and the OliveTech contacts you flagged during the demo.

High-level asks from your side (so we can finalize dates):
- Confirm pilot scope (2 features: conversational FAQ + contextual retrieval).
- Confirm 4-week pilot window and available test data sets.
- Allocate a single technical point of contact for infra/network (Raj was suggested).

I’ve included Monica (CS lead) and Neha (solutions/infra) on this thread so they can sign up owners and call out any infra gating items. If the dates in the sheet look good we’ll convert to a shared Drive doc and generate a formal SOW draft for procurement.

Thanks,

Jasmine —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear breakdown. A few notes after I reviewed the MAP:

- Pilot scope: Confirmed for Conversational FAQ + Retrieval; we can provide a 6k doc corpus and one query set.
- Pilot window: We prefer Week of May 6 for pilot start, with 4 weeks for evaluation (May 6–June 2). Can you shift the pilot dates accordingly?
- POC contacts: Raj will be the infra POC (cc’d). Procurement will need an SOW and a ballpark cost estimate before internal approval.

We have one gating item on data residency for logs — legal needs assurance about retention windows and access. Can your security/compliance team provide a short note on retention and log access?

Sounds good to me to move the sheet to Drive once dates are adjusted.

Thanks,
Claire Wang

claire@olivetech.com

Thanks Claire — great call alignment. I updated the MAP sheet with the proposed pilot dates (May 6 start) and added owner assignments on our side for each milestone. Quick notes on sequencing and responsibilities:

- Week 0 (Prep): Secure sample data set, share sanitized subset with Neha for schema review (owner: Claire / OliveTech).
- Week 1–4 (Pilot): Implementation sprint for model integration + monitoring (owner: Monica for delivery; Neha for infra).
- Week 5–6 (Evaluation): Joint QA and acceptance criteria runbook (owner: Claire/OliveTech).
- Week 7–8 (Scale): Optional performance tuning and quantization recommendations (owner: Marcus).

I also added a risk column — initial items: data residency question, infra IP allowlist, and shared test credentials lifecycle. Marcus will add an infra diagram and a short mitigation plan for the allowlist requirement.

I’ll move the sheet to Drive and share a link (view/comment) so OliveTech procurement can see the milestone-based SOW flow.

Attachment references: SOW draft placeholder will be uploaded once dates locked.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Claire / Team —

I attached a lightweight infra diagram and a short runbook for the pilot allowlist and connection test. Two items I want to flag as potential schedule slippage:

1) Network allowlist: OliveTech will need to confirm firewall/IP ranges and expected lead time for their network team to push rules. If Raj can provision at least a dev CIDR by May 1 we should still meet the May 6 pilot start.

2) Data ingestion: The sample corpus needs minor normalization; Neha and I estimate 3 business days to validate once the sanitized export is shared.

I’ve suggested a contingency: if network gating is delayed, we can run a sandboxed, offline pilot against a static snapshot (reduced monitoring) to preserve the evaluation window. That would require sign-off from Claire for acceptance criteria relaxations.

Claire / Raj / Procurement —

Thanks for the confirmations. New summary and next steps:

- Pilot start: Monday, May 6 — confirmed.
- Deliverables before pilot: sanitized corpus (OliveTech), firewall CIDR or sandbox access (Raj), signed pilot SOW placeholder from procurement for billing hold.
- Owners: OliveTech (Claire/Raj) — data & network; Redwood (Monica/Neha/Marcus) — integration, infra, runbook.
- Contingency: If network allowlist is not in place by May 1, we’ll execute the offline snapshot pilot per Marcus’s contingency and log acceptance criteria exceptions in the MAP.

I uploaded the updated MAP and a placeholder SOW to Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1OliveTechMAP. Monica — please take point on generating the SOW draft and loop procurement when ready.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Claire: share sanitized export by May 1.
- Raj: provide CIDR or sandbox access by May 1.
- Monica: SOW draft by Apr 28 for procurement review.
- Marcus/Neha: infra validation checklist by May 3.

Looking forward — we’ll plan a short kickoff (30 min) on May 6 to align the first-week runbook. I’ll send a calendar invite once SOW placeholder is in place.
